crossRefs.note: As often as the king entered into Yahweh’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard…

parallels.note: As often as the king entered into Yahweh’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard…

translations.web: It was so, that as often as the king went into Yahweh’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.
translations.bsb: And whenever the king entered the house of the LORD, the guards would bear the shields, and later they would return them to the guardroom.
translations.kjv: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
translations.asv: And it was so, that, as oft as the king went into the house of Jehovah, the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard-chamber.
